item.title: The three fixed orchestration agents: Sequential / Parallel / Loop, their implementation semantics and boundaries
item.description: The three agent/workflowagents packages in ADK Go v2.4.0: Config wraps a single agent.Config (LoopAgent adds MaxIterations uint), all three reject a custom Run, Sequential's fixed ordering and RunLive entry point, Parallel's errgroup plus <parent>.<child> branch naming and early-stop cancellation with teardown waiting, Loop's count==0 indefinite loop and Actions.Escalate exit, and where the selection boundary lies against the graph workflow engine.

item.title: Module 5: The Graph Workflow Engine (core of ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: A complete tour of the workflow package: node types, Chain/EdgeBuilder/fan-out-join, routing, concurrent scheduling with per-node retry and timeouts, and HITL pause/resume with dynamic graphs
